messages:
sara: Quick live thread from today's All-Hands Q&A on remote/hybrid, travel & offsites. I'll answer what we can now; drop questions and we'll update the FAQ. :wave:

anya: For recurring team days (e.g., monthly planning week), is that a manager decision or needs GM sign-off?

sara: Managers set team norms. If it conflicts with other teams or needs building resources, alert your GM so we can coordinate.

mike: Commute/parking stipend status? I heard the pilot is ending in some cities.

sara: Correct  SF and Denver commuter pilots wrap this quarter. We'll evaluate expanding; changes get 30 days notice. For individual parking needs, People Ops can review exceptions.

leo: Offsite policy: are partners/family covered? Any stipend?

sara: We're running a limited partner/childcare stipend pilot for selected 2026 offsites. Eligibility and application details will be on the travel page. Managers can request exceptions for key contributors.

ops-bot: Reminder: submit travel requests 21 days ahead for domestic, 30+ days for international (visas).

anya: Visa letters and reimbursements?

sara: People Ops issues invitation/attendance letters for company events. Visa fees reimbursed if pre-approved on the travel request form; use the "visa_support" field.

mike: Who approves date or budget exceptions (extra nights, partner travel)?

sara: Operational exceptions = manager + People Ops; budget exceptions escalate to Finance + GM.

leo: Can teams reserve a block of desks or conference rooms for offsite weeks? Timeline?

sara: Yes  submit a facilities request at least 7 business days ahead for AV, badge access, and desk blocks. Permanent reserved desks can be requested quarterly.

mike: Preferred vendors for flights/hotels? Any PO process?

sara: Preferred vendors are in the travel form dropdown. If you need a PO or a vendor isn't listed, choose "other" and tag procurement; finance@redwood handles POs. Use project code EXP-OFFSITE-2026 for offsite expenses.

anya: ADA accommodations? Confidential process?

sara: Contact People Ops privately and we'll handle accommodations confidentially.

ops-bot: Expense tip: target reimbursement within 12 business days after submission when code EXP-OFFSITE-2026 is used.

sara: Action items I will do: 1) Update remote/hybrid FAQ and pin it in People Ops by next Tue. 2) Publish manager checklist for team in-office norms. 3) Add childcare stipend pilot details to the travel page and vendor list to the form. I'll post links when live and ping eng-leads.

leo: Thanks  very helpful.

mike: Appreciate it  will share with my managers.
